text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, Acute-san!
The Japan Dirt Derby was incredible☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I was deeply moved too. To think she could run with such sheer tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Tarumae-chan,
Rickey-chan.
—The aftermath of a fiercely fought battle. Wonder Acute's run seems to have ignited a burning spark in her juniors' hearts as well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the only bummer was
not being able to go there in person.
Since we had training and all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you were so good
looking after the place on your own. And for such a good Rickey-chan,
here's a little treat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here, have some strawberry ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wah, really!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Strawberry pink is today's lucky color☆ Thank you, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And for Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine with it. It truly moved me, after all.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "An Umadol doesn't receive; she gives. Even Falco-san, whom I respect so much, says so."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Don't need any ice cream or trinkets, then?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll give this
to Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The~re, Maru!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... You're giving me a favorite mark?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You worked super hard in training today.
Gold star! A big, round circle for you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm starting to feel
a little happy... This feels nice.
While giving rewards to each of them—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Teyaaaaah, as a local idol,
I'll put Tomakomai on the map...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh, to spread feng shui
and make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant* I won't lose to Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who absolutely cannot lose to Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, there, there. It's great to be eager,
but you two get along now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uhh-ooh!
Uhh-ooh☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm, Trainer, what should I do...?
choice_data_list: Why don't you two do a different training together?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Different training...! That's a good idea.
Whenever they run, sparks fly between them anyway.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, Rickey-chan,
how about we try something else then?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Sure, but what are we doing instead?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you know of any
good training methods?
A training session that can only be done at a training camp, together with Wonder Acute. What came to mind was...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, shadowboxing!
That's my specialty, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I remember pounding away at the punching bag in my family's gym all the time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Boxing...
Come to think of it, there are dance exercises
like that too, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I kinda want to try it!
Acute-san, teach me, teach me☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, Rickey-chan,
watch closely, it's like this, see?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Sh! Sh-sh!
Fuh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa... She's like a totally different person...!

It had a strange sharpness to it.
Each powerful blow sliced through the air.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Like this? Is this right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh-uh-uh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Where you place your center of gravity is completely different from dancing.
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhohoho. Like this, see? Like this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Sh! Sh-sh!

The three of them trained together in high spirits.
Thanks to the boxing training,
their legs and core were strengthened considerably.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"A diving match! Yeah, why not?
We're at the beach, after all."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How about the three of us have a free-diving contest?
To see who can stay underwater the longest.
And heading out near the cliff—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah.
Well, I suppose that'll do.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san?!
Have you been submerged this whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Incredible lung capacity... Just what kind
of training gets someone to this level...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Despite how I look, I was born with a strong heart.
The doctor even gave me his personal guarantee, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
While diving, I gathered a bunch of shellfish too,
so let's all eat them together~

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Rickey
text_block_list.text: An ama diver!?

And the summer days flew by
in the blink of an eye—
(BOOOM! KABOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tamaya~! Kagiya~!
And then, uhm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Takasagoya~...?
...I didn't quite understand the chants for the fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is a great training camp, huh.
By training together with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can feel my strength growing so fast.
If I keep this up...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Before long, Falco-san's back might come into view.
If I can catch up to her...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it'll give hope to everyone working hard on their comeback.
Showing them that 'if you keep at it steadily, you'll definitely get there!'"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can do that,
there's nothing more I could ever want. Nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's why, Trainer...!
If Wonder Acute wants to be a support for others, then my role is to be the support for Wonder Acute.
I will support Wonder Acute and make sure her dream comes true.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "And I'm not the only one aiming to be like Falco-san."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of other girls aiming for that and working hard, too.
Like Tarumae-chan and Rickey-chan...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hope the two of them can catch up to Falco-san
someday too.

While replying, there was something on my mind.
Just one thing I had to know, no matter what.
Wonder Acute chases after Smart Falcon. And... the underclassmen chase after Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is something the matter?
Why, in that vision of the future—

Is there no room for
"Wonder Acute the senior"
whom her juniors can look up to?
